PWM으로 LED 밝기·숨쉬기: LED brightness and breathing with PWM
D3(PB3, TIM2_CH2)의 PWM으로 LED 밝기를 바꾸고, LD: Change the LED brightness with PWM on D3 (PB3, TIM2_CH2), and measure LD2's breathing pattern with the oscilloscope.
PWM의 주파수와 듀티비를 구분해 설명한다: Explain the difference between PWM frequency and duty cycle
듀티비가 평균 전압·밝기를 정한다는 것을 측정으로 확인한다: Confirm by measurement that the duty cycle sets the average voltage and brightness
타이머 채널이 정해진 핀(대체 기능, AF)에만 나온다는 것을 안다: Understand that a timer channel comes out only on specific pins (alternate function, AF)
LED를 **D3** (PB3)에 연결하세요. PB3은 TIM2의 채널: Connect the LED to **D3** (PB3). PB3 is a pin that can be used as TIM2 channel 2 (TIM2_CH2).
**PWM**(펄스 폭 변조): 핀을 아주 빠르게(여기서는 1 kHz,: **PWM** (pulse-width modulation): switch the pin on and off very fast (here 1 kHz, every 1 ms) and change the fraction of time it is on = the **duty cycle**.
- 듀티 25 % → 평균 0.25 × 3.3 V ≈ 0.8 V, LED: - Duty 25 % → average 0.25 × 3.3 V ≈ 0.8 V, the LED is dim
The eye cannot follow a 1 kHz flicker and sees the average brightness.
**▶ 실행**하면 D3의 LED가 서서히 밝아졌다 어두워지고, 보드의: Press **▶ Run**: the LED on D3 slowly brightens and dims, and the board's **LD2** (PA5, TIM2_CH1) breathes every 2 seconds.
오실로스코프 탭에서 PA5를 프로브하고 측정값의 **듀티**가 0 %에서: Probe PA5 in the Oscilloscope tab and watch the measured **duty** change from 0 % to 100 %. The frequency stays at 1 kHz.
카운터가 0부터 ARR(999)까지 세는 동안 CCR보다 작으면 High: While the counter counts from 0 to ARR (999), the output is High when it is below CCR and Low when above (PWM mode 1). CCR = 250 gives a duty of 25 %.
LED가 켜지지 않으면 D3 대신 D2/D4에 꽂혔는지 보세요. PWM은: If the LED does not light, check whether it is plugged into D2/D4 instead of D3. PWM only comes out on pins connected to a timer channel.
LD2(PA5) 듀티 5 % 이하인 순간: A moment with LD2 (PA5) duty at 5 % or less
LD2(PA5) 듀티 90 % 이상인 순간: A moment with LD2 (PA5) duty at 90 % or more
PWM 주파수와 밝기를 혼동 — 밝기는 듀티비가 정하고, 주파수는 깜빡임: Confusing PWM frequency with brightness — the duty cycle sets the brightness; the frequency only needs to be high enough that no flicker is visible.
아무 핀에서나 PWM이 나온다고 생각 — TIM2_CH2는 PA1, PB: Assuming PWM comes out of any pin — TIM2_CH2 is connected only to specific pins such as PA1 and PB3 (the AF table in the datasheet).
